findings.quote: The page showed a switch promotion of up to 6 months of free payroll ending November 26 (terms apply).  /  The ADP RUN page showed a switch promotion of up to 6 months of free payroll, ending November 26 and subject to terms.
findings.problem: Wrong date. ADP's linked offer terms (https://www.adp.com/terms/6-month-offer-terms-sbs) say the company must sign and start processing payroll by November 30, 2026. The RUN page itself shows no end date at all ('Get up to 6 months FREE payroll*'). The table row and ADP section both state November 26.
findings.fix: Replace with 'start processing payroll by November 30, 2026 (terms apply)' in both places, or drop the date.

findings.quote: Gusto cites a 4.6-star average on Capterra from 4,137 reviews and 4.6 on Software Advice.
